--- updatedAt: 2025-10-28T20:21:39.000Z agentTools: siteIndex: https://developer.monday.com/llms.txt projectIndex: https://developer.monday.com/apps/llms.txt --- # monday.com MCP integration
Beta: This feature is in testing and may change as improvements are made.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard that allows large language models (LLMs) to perform actions on behalf of users. The monday.com MCP server integration connects your preferred AI agent with your monday.com boards, enabling it to act on your behalf. You can empower agents like Claude, Cursor, and Copilot to: * Automatically create new items for specific tasks * Create and populate new boards * Add custom activities in the monday.com CRM * Update board columns (e.g., change statuses, add due dates, assign team members) * Write item updates and summaries You can also use the MCP server to build your own AI agents or integrate AI features into your apps.
🧩 Explore our MCP server and its supported tools on Github here.
# Supported agents MCP is currently supported by: * [Claude Desktop](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/quickstart/user) * [Cursor](https://docs.cursor.com/context/model-context-protocol) * [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/chat/mcp-servers) * [Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agent-extend-action-mcp) Additional agents will be supported in the future. # Implementation ## Prerequisites Before using the server, make sure you have: * Node.js v20 or higher installed * NPM v5.2.0 or higher installed * A monday.com [API token](https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/authentication) ## Add monday.com MCP to your agent To get started, add the monday.com MCP server to your agent’s MCP configuration. Be sure to replace `"your_monday_API_token"` with your monday.com API token: ```json { "mcpServers": { "monday-api-mcp": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "@mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp", "-t", "your_monday_API_token", "--enable-dynamic-api-tools", "true" ] } } } ``` ## Pass API token as an environment variable If your agent supports environment variables, pass your monday.com API token like this: ```json { "mcpServers": { "monday-api-mcp": { "command": "npx", "args": [ "@mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp" ], "env": { "monday_token": "abcd123" } } } } ``` ## Run a local MCP server For local development and debugging, you can run the MCP server manually: ```shell Terminal npx @mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp -t "YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" ```
